Maulana Qari Muhammad Tayyib was one of the foremost scholar of Islamic sciences in the Indian Subcontient in 20th century. A grandson of Maulana Muhammad Qasim Nanautavi, the founder of Darul Uloom Deoband, he served as rector of the Darul Uloom for more than half a century.

Born in 1897 he was educated at Darul Uloom. He served as teacher at his alma mater and then as rector of Darul Uloom Deoband from 1928 to 1980. He was among founders of All India Muslim Personal Law Board and headed it until his death. He also founder Muslim Majlis Mushawarat Besides being an accomlished author he was also a good poet and wrote devotional poetry or naat.

Nabi e Akram Shafi e Azam, Dukhe diloN ka salam le lo, a very popular naat was penned by him. His poetical compositions have been published as Irfan-e-Arif.

https://youtu.be/hRIgMXfhzo4 Qari Mohammad Tayyib is credited for a complete turnaround as far as madraa at Deoband is concerned. His efforts brought Darul Uloom Deoband on peak of fame and during his rectory throughout the Islamic world Darul Uloom Deoband became to be acknowledged as the al-Azhar of East. His publishd work is huge.

Most important work of Qari Tayyab sahib include Al-Tashabbuh fil-Islam, Mashaheer-e-Ummat, Kalimat-e-Tayyibat, Atyab al-Thamar fi Mas’alat al-Qaza wal-Qadr, Science aur Islam, Talimat-e-Islam aur Maseehi Aqwaam, Mas’alah Zuban-e-Urdu Hindustan Mein,Din-o-Siyasat, Asbab Urooj-o-Zawaley Aqwaam, Islami Azadi Ka Mukammal Program, Al-Ijtehad wal Taqleed, Usool Dawat-e-Islam, Islami Masawat, Fitri Hukumat. His work has been translated in multiple languages across the world. He passed away in 1983 after a long and eventful life.
